description: Search Stocktwits for symbols and users by keyword (the site's search box). ENTITY search only — finds tickers (stocks/crypto with symbol, company name, exchange, optional watchlist count and country) and user accounts (username, name, avatar, official/premium/verified flags), NOT posts by content (the platform has no post search). Returns what the site's search dropdown shows; the public endpoint has no pagination. Anonymous public API — no login, no browser needed.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keyword — a ticker fragment, company name, or username, e.g. "AAPL" or "fredwilson".
